brief: c107: arrivals come in twos on the lane and from the east since #70, but the courtyard's own spawnAgent still sends every sitter and crosser alone, so from the wide shot the pairs stop at the courtyard wall. Call withCompanion(a, room) from spawnAgent with the courtyard's own cap (capacity) as the room test, and make pairTarget's bench case work on BENCH_SPOTS (the courtyard bench is the same 1.5 cells — shift the leader, seat the companion). Leave the concert crowd alone (its own source, nine claimed slots) and leave a.mate (the picnic) as it is — but say in the entry whether a.mate and a.with should become one mechanism.
successLooksLike: probes/pairs.mjs extended to the courtyard: a quarter of courtyard arrivals with room bring a companion, separation in [0.9, 1.6], both on the bench; courtyard peak population unchanged.
avoid: No new draws in a branch that already has room decided — keep the roll unconditional as #70 did. Do not touch the concert or the picnic.
